corrections: Clarkson qualification is BS in Electrical and Electronics Engineering. Stanford Graduate School of Business Executive Education Program is not an MBA or degree equivalence. No graduation year used because targeted university search did not establish it.
SoftBank biography gives October 2006 NVIDIA computing-products VP/general manager and October 2013 Arm strategic-alliances VP. NVIDIA former employment does not establish current employment there.
IP Products Group presidency begins January 2017, not CEO tenure. January 2015 commercial promotion is distinct; no full chronology inferred from rounded two-year wording.

Arm announcement dates CEO and board appointment February 8, 2022, effective immediately, succeeding Simon Segars. SoftBank biography separates Arm Limited in 2022 and Arm Holdings plc in September 2023; generic Arm role avoids conflating legal-entity histories.
IPO ADS trading began September 14, 2023, registration effective September 13, offering closed September 18. No claim that this was a personal sale of all Haas holdings or all proceeds went to him.

March 24, 2026 launch expands beyond IP/CSS to Arm-designed silicon; Meta is lead partner. Avoid obsolete description as exclusively IP licensing. No claim Haas invented Arm or personally engineered every chip.

April 21, 2026 SBGI CEO appointment is concurrent with Arm CEO and directorship. SBGI coordinates certain international subsidiaries, not SoftBank Group Corp. CEO succession; Masayoshi Son is not replaced by this announcement.

November 4 release covers quarter ended September 30, 2026, Q2 FY2027. Revenue, royalties, licensing and other revenue, GAAP and non-GAAP operating income are different metrics. No numerical profit simplification adopted.

November results say initial AGI CPU commercial deliveries remain on track for Q4 FY2027, with targets spanning FY2027/FY2028 and orders into calendar 2027. March launch and customer orders do not establish completed commercial delivery or realized future revenue.
November 13 search results report NVIDIA approaching Haas; being approached is not an accepted appointment. Current official roles remain Arm and SBGI; speculative succession not added.
